claims.evidence: Witness report shows a portable blue metal gas burner/stand assembly; no full cooker/oven or brand/model shown.
Report does not include rust/dents/usage indicators or a test/inspection; only the burner/stand appearance is described.
No receipt/warranty card is shown in the witness report.
No lighting/flame test, valve/igniter check, or leak check is described.
Witness report describes a gas burner/stand; no motor is shown or referenced in the observations.
Not shown in the witness report.

risks.risk: Not actually complete for use (missing regulator, hose, knobs/burner cap) or mismatched parts
risks.proof: A photo/clip showing the full set laid out (burner, knobs/caps, regulator, hose, any fittings) with close-ups of connection ends and labels.
risks.if_unproven: Price as incomplete/unknown completeness (worst-case: needs missing parts) and treat as not ready to connect.

risks.risk: Gas safety issues: valve/regulator/hose condition and possible leaks
risks.proof: A short video of a leak test (soap-bubble test at all joints) and a successful ignition with steady flame.
risks.if_unproven: Price as untested for leaks and assume safety risk; discount accordingly.

risks.risk: Burner performance problems (clogged ports, weak flame, warped grate/ring causing uneven burning)
risks.proof: A clip showing ignition and flame pattern from multiple angles, plus a close-up of burner ports/grate for warping or blockage.
risks.if_unproven: Price as potentially weak/uneven burner (worst-case: requires cleaning/repair).

risks.risk: Physical condition not captured (rust, dents, corrosion, heat damage) affecting longevity
risks.proof: Close-up photos of all metal surfaces (top, underside, legs, ring/spokes) under good light, including any rust spots and dents.
risks.if_unproven: Price at worst visible condition (assume possible corrosion/heat wear).

risks.risk: Size/compatibility risk (does it fit standard cylinder/regulator type in Abuja)
risks.proof: A photo showing the connection interface and a measurement reference (ruler/tape) or a clip showing it connected to the correct cylinder/regulator type.
risks.if_unproven: Price as compatibility-uncertain (worst-case: may need adapter/incorrect regulator).

proof_requests: Send clear photos of the entire item set laid out: burner, knobs/caps, regulator, hose, and any fittings (including connection ends).
Provide a short video: connect to a cylinder/regulator, ignite, and show steady flame from at least two angles.
Show a soap-bubble leak test at every joint (regulator-to-hose, hose-to-burner, valve area).
Provide close-ups of burner ports/grate/spokes and the underside/legs to confirm no warping or heavy corrosion.
Share receipt/warranty card photos (if available) showing date and item details.
response.reason: The witness can identify the item type as a portable gas burner/stand, so it can be priced at its worst-case as an untested, possibly incomplete burner assembly; seller claims about being industrial, barely used, and no faults are not verifiable from the report.
